- scripts/provider_outage.py:line 579 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]

  PROBLEM: `_probe_body_error_status` treats an HTTP 200 response body containing `{"error": {}}` as no error, allowing recovery to be reported while the provider still indicates an error.
  WHY: The empty error object is falsy, so the probe can close the outage marker and resume reviews; severity ranges from NIT to BLOCKER, and the highest severity is used.
- scripts/provider_outage.py:line 863 — `result.update({"recovered": True, ...})` before lines 868-869 PATCH loop | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The result is marked recovered before the marker-close PATCH completes, so a PATCH exception leaves `recovered=True` alongside an error.
  WHY: The tick output can misleadingly report recovery even though the marker stayed open.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:lines 327-355 (the release-run provider-outage block) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: When a release run has no provider-outage evidence but an outage marker is open, the intake exits without diagnosing an unrelated release failure.
  WHY: The highest reported severity is BLOCKER; deepseek, minimax, and qwen flag this as a defect, while z-ai_glm-5_2 says the behavior is documented and intended.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: "release runs that failed solely because of provider_unavailable" (plan and Copilot review comment at entry[24) are deferred to the marker; unrelated release failures during an open outage must continue through normal intake diagnosis.

  confidence=[5]

  EVIDENCE: The `case` statement at line 344 matches `created|exists|duplicate_closed` unconditionally, and the `provider_outage_record` call at line 342 uses `--only-if-open` (which never creates a marker, only records on an existing one) without gating the exit on whether the release itself had `PROVIDER_OUTAGE_LINE` set. The contract test at tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:3352-3362 asserts the deferred (no-diagnosis) behavior as the expected one.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  WHY: Such a release defect may go undiagnosed for the outage duration and is not re-run by default.
